<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-Hant-TW">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#10204b"><title>HIKUN 月球電台</title>
<style>
:root{font-family:system-ui,"Noto Sans TC",sans-serif;color:#192952;background:#f3f0ff;--ink:#182952;--blue:#253c93;--yellow:#ffdd73}
*{box-sizing:border-box} body{margin:0} button,input{font:inherit} a{color:inherit} button{cursor:pointer} button:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.65} :focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ac3c27;outline-offset:3px}
.skip{position:absolute;left:1rem;top:-5rem;background:white;padding:.65rem;z-index:9}.skip:focus{top:.5rem}
header{background:#101d43;color:#fff}.bar{max-width:1180px;margin:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:15px 24px;gap:12px}.brand{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em}.brand span{color:var(--yellow);margin-right:.55rem}.bar a{font-size:.86rem}
main{max-width:1180px;margin:36px auto 20px;padding:0 24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns: .91fr 1.22fr;gap:22px;align-items:start}.hero{padding:30px;border-radius:27px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 59%,#4957a5 0%,#29396f 43%,#14214c 77%);overflow:hidden;color:white;min-height:590px;position:relative}.freq{font:700 .75rem ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--yellow)}h1{font-size:clamp(2.35rem,5vw,4.2rem);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.055em;margin:18px 0 12px}h1 small{display:block;font-size:.52em;letter-spacing:.03em;margin-top:9px}.intro{color:#e2e7ff;font-size:.94rem;margin:0}.orbit{height:280px;position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;isolation:isolate}.orbit:before,.orbit:after{content:"";position:absolute;border:1px solid #c8d2ff4a;border-radius:50%;width:93%;height:45%;transform:rotate(-19deg);z-index:-1}.orbit:after{width:75%;height:66%;transform:rotate(23deg)}.star{position:absolute;color:var(--yellow);font-size:1.65rem}.one{left:10%;top:34%}.two{right:10%;top:24%}.three{right:22%;bottom:12%}.mascot{width:258px;height:258px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 16px #10173aa0);z-index:1}.hero.pulse .mascot{animation:hop .45s ease}@keyframes hop{50%{transform:translateY(-13px)}}.signal{background:#111d42b0;border:1px solid #a8b7f65c;border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}.signal p{margin:0;font-size:.85rem}.signal strong{display:block;color:#ffe38c;margin-bottom:4px}.signal button{border:0;background:#ffe38c;color:#17294f;border-radius:24px;padding:9px 12px;font-weight:800;min-height:44px}.credit{margin:15px 0 0;font-size:.73rem;color:#e5e9ff}
.panel{background:#fff;border-radius:27px;border:1px solid #dddff3;min-width:0;box-shadow:0 13px 32px #2c225a0c;overflow:hidden}.panelhead{padding:17px 19px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e7f2}.identity{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.avatar{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:13px;color:#192952;background:#ffe391;font-weight:900;flex:none}.avatar img{width:35px;height:36px;object-fit:contain}.panel h2{margin:0;font-size:1.05rem}.sub{font-size:.75rem;margin:3px 0 0;color:#46577c}.tools{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:end}.tools button,.chip,.speak{color:#263978;background:#f3f4fe;border:1px solid #dce1f7;border-radius:16px;padding:7px 10px;min-height:44px;font-size:.77rem;font-weight:750}.tools button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#273e9a;color:white}.log{height:315px;overflow:auto;padding:20px;scroll-padding:15px;background:#fafaff}.entry{max-width:87%;margin:0 0 15px}.entry.user{margin-left:auto}.who{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:850;margin:0 0 4px}.user .who{text-align:right}.bubble{background:#ebeefe;border-radius:4px 16px 16px;padding:11px 14px;line-height:1.65;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:.91rem}.user .bubble{background:#253c93;color:#fff;border-radius:16px 4px 16px 16px}.bubble p{margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap}.source{display:block;width:fit-content;margin-top:7px;font-size:.75rem}.speak{margin-top:6px;background:white}.composer{padding:14px 19px 17px}.chips{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:11px}.chip{background:#fff}.chip:hover,.tools button:hover,.speak:hover{border-color:#3b54ad}.row{display:flex;gap:7px}.row input{min-width:0;flex:1;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #a7afcf;border-radius:12px;color:var(--ink);min-height:46px}.primary,.mic{min-height:46px;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 12px;font-weight:800}.primary{background:#253c93;color:#fff}.mic{background:#e9edff;color:#24336a}.mic[aria-pressed=true]{background:#fee1a5}.status{font-size:.77rem;color:#425478;min-height:2.4em;margin:8px 0 0}.foot{padding:8px 24px 22px;text-align:center;color:#46577c;font-size:.78rem}.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:790px){main{grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:610px;margin-top:17px}.hero{min-height:0;padding:23px}.orbit{height:240px}.mascot{height:224px;width:224px}.log{height:315px}}
@media(max-width:460px){main{padding:0 12px;gap:14px}.bar{padding:12px}.composer,.panelhead,.log{padding-left:12px;padding-right:12px}.hero{padding:19px}.orbit{height:205px}.mascot{width:185px;height:185px}.entry{max-width:94%}.row input{font-size:16px}.primary,.mic{padding-inline:8px}.tools button{padding-inline:7px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
</style></head>
<body>
<a class="skip" href="#prompt">跳到聊天輸入</a>
<header><div class="bar"><div class="brand"><span aria-hidden="true">✦</span> HIKUN RADIO</div><a href="#chat">前往聊天</a></div></header>
<main>
<section class="hero" id="hero" aria-labelledby="title">
<div class="freq">FM 08.20 · MOON RADIO</div>
<h1 id="title">HIKUN<small>月球電台</small></h1>
<p class="intro">問我 TRUZ 小知識，或來領取一則月球訊號。</p>
<div class="orbit">
<span class="star one" aria-hidden="true">✧</span><span class="star two" aria-hidden="true">✦</span><span class="star three" aria-hidden="true">✧</span>
<img class="mascot" src="data:image/png;base64," width="258" height="258" alt="HIKUN 戴著紅色小帽，睜著圓眼睛，一隻手扶著臉">
</div>
<div class="signal"><p><strong>月球來訊</strong>收一張 HIKUN 的星光明信片。</p><button type="button" id="signal">接收訊號</button></div>
<p class="credit">TRUZ 粉絲課堂作品 · <a href="https://linefriends.com/ko-kr/characters-list/ip-truz">LINE FRIENDS 角色資料</a></p>
</section>
<section class="panel" id="chat" aria-labelledby="chat-title">
<div class="panelhead"><div class="identity"><span class="avatar" aria-hidden="true"><img src="data:image/png;base64," width="35" height="36" alt=""></span><div><h2 id="chat-title">跟 HIKUN 對話</h2><p class="sub">角色問答 · 電台互動</p></div></div><div class="tools"><button id="voice" type="button" aria-pressed="false">自動朗讀</button><button id="reset" type="button">重開對話</button></div></div>
<div class="log" id="log" role="log" aria-label="聊天記錄" aria-live="polite" tabindex="0"></div>
<div class="composer">
<div class="chips" aria-label="快速提問"><button class="chip" type="button">HIKUN 是誰？</button><button class="chip" type="button">TRUZ 的故事</button><button class="chip" type="button">其他角色</button><button class="chip" type="button">幫我打氣</button></div>
<form id="form"><label class="sr" for="prompt">輸入訊息</label><div class="row"><input id="prompt" enterkeyhint="send" placeholder="輸入你想問的問題…" maxlength="240" required><button id="mic" class="mic" type="button" aria-pressed="false">語音</button><button class="primary" type="submit">送出</button></div></form>
<p id="status" class="status" role="status">可打字或點選快速提問。語音輸入需瀏覽器支援及麥克風權限。</p>
<noscript><p>請啟用 JavaScript 以使用聊天功能。</p></noscript>
</div></section>
</main>
<footer class="foot">角色設定屬於 TRUZ／LINE FRIENDS。月球電台與明信片為本作品原創情境。<a href="https://www.deviantart.com/bt21fanart/art/TRUZ-Hikun-Pose-1072015107">角色原圖：Bt21Fanart</a></footer>
<script type="application/json" id="knowledge">
[
{"id":"hikun","title":"HIKUN","keys":["hikun","機器人","個性","表情","你是誰","你叫什麼","喜坤","希坤"],"text":"HIKUN 是 TRUZ 裡情感豐富的機器人。剛認識時可能有點冷淡，熟了以後就會露出各種搞怪的表情。","source":"https://linefriends.com/ko-kr/characters-list/ip-truz"},
{"id":"story","title":"TRUZ 故事","keys":["truz","故事","實驗室","背景","設定","由來","世界觀"],"text":"TRUZ 的故事從實驗室開始。大家醒來後記不起自己的來歷，只知道每個人都有特殊能力，於是一起踏上尋找自我的旅程。","source":"https://linefriends.com/ko-kr/characters-list/ip-truz"},
{"id":"ruru","title":"RURU","keys":["ruru","棉花糖"],"text":"RURU 是小小的棉花糖角色，能讓冷掉的氣氛變暖，也可以複製自己的身體。","source":"https://linefriends.com/ko-kr/characters-list/ip-truz"},
{"id":"chilli","title":"CHILLI","keys":["chilli","辣椒"],"text":"CHILLI 想成為帥氣的角色。只要下定決心，即使熬夜也會把事情做完。","source":"https://linefriends.com/ko-kr/characters-list/ip-truz"},
{"id":"romy","title":"ROMY","keys":["romy","玫瑰"],"text":"ROMY 是笑容迷人的白玫瑰，喜歡唱歌跳舞，總能讓周圍的氣氛更明亮。","source":"https://linefriends.com/ko-kr/characters-list/ip-truz"},
{"id":"friends","title":"其他角色","keys":["其他角色","角色有哪些","朋友","還有誰","角色介紹","角色"],"text":"TRUZ 的角色有 RURU、CHILLI 和 ROMY 等。你可以直接輸入名字，聽我介紹其中一位。","source":"https://linefriends.com/ko-kr/characters-list/ip-truz"}
]
</script>
<script>
const byId = id => document.getElementById(id);
const knowledge = JSON.parse(byId('knowledge').textContent);
const log = byId('log'), prompt = byId('prompt'), status = byId('status');
const voice = byId('voice'), mic = byId('mic');
const greeting = '嗶——這裡是 HIKUN 月球電台！想知道我在 TRUZ 裡的故事，還是想收一張星光明信片？';
const postcards = [
  '月球明信片 01／窗外一片黑的時候，也還是有星星。今天可以先做一件小事，剩下的明天再說。',
  '月球明信片 02／收到你的訊號了。累的話先休息一下，等你有力氣再回來，我會留著這個頻道。',
  '月球明信片 03／今天的星星有點慢才亮。沒關係，你也可以慢慢來。'
];
const normalize = text => text.normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase().replace(/[\p{P}\p{Z}\s]+/gu,'');
let postcard = 0, lastTopic = null, speaking = false, recognition = null;
function read(text) {
  if (!('speechSynthesis' in window) || !('SpeechSynthesisUtterance' in window)) return;
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'zh-TW'; utterance.rate = .93;
  utterance.onerror = e => {if (!['canceled','interrupted'].includes(e.error)) status.textContent = '語音暫時無法播放，請閱讀對話文字。';};
  speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}
function add(name, content, source) {
  const entry = document.createElement('div');
  entry.className = name === '你' ? 'entry user' : 'entry';
  const who = document.createElement('p'); who.className = 'who'; who.textContent = name;
  const bubble = document.createElement('div'); bubble.className = 'bubble';
  const body = document.createElement('p'); body.textContent = content; bubble.append(body);
  if (source) {
    const link = document.createElement('a'); link.className = 'source'; link.href = source;
    link.target = '_blank'; link.rel = 'noopener'; link.textContent = 'LINE FRIENDS 角色資料（新分頁）'; bubble.append(link);
  }
  entry.append(who,bubble);
  if (name !== '你' && !voice.disabled) {
    const button = document.createElement('button'); button.className = 'speak';
    button.type = 'button'; button.textContent = '朗讀這則'; button.addEventListener('click',() => read(content)); entry.append(button);
  }
  log.append(entry); log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
  if (speaking && name !== '你') read(content);
}
function retrieve(question, previous) {
  const normalized = normalize(question);
  const ranked = knowledge.map(doc => ({
    doc,
    score: doc.keys.reduce((score,key) => normalized.includes(key) ? score + key.length ** 2 : score,0)
  })).sort((a,b) => b.score - a.score);
  if (ranked[0].score > 0) return ranked[0].doc;
  if (/^(他|她|牠|它|你)?(還有呢|詳細一點|再說一次|呢)$/.test(normalized)) return previous;
  return null;
}
function card() {
  const hero = byId('hero');
  hero.classList.remove('pulse'); void hero.offsetWidth; hero.classList.add('pulse');
  add('HIKUN',postcards[postcard]);
  postcard = (postcard + 1) % postcards.length;
}
function send(raw) {
  const question = raw.trim();
  if (!question) {status.textContent = '請輸入一點文字再送出。'; return;}
  add('你',question);
  if (/打氣|明信片|訊號|心情不好|好累|加油/.test(question)) {card(); return;}
  if (/^(你好|哈囉|嗨|hi|hello)$/.test(normalize(question))) {add('HIKUN',greeting); return;}
  if (/演唱會|票價|行程|今天幾點|購買|哪裡買|最新消息|生日/.test(question)) {
    add('HIKUN','我的資料庫目前收錄 TRUZ 的故事和角色介紹，找不到這項資訊。你可以先問我「HIKUN 是誰？」'); return;
  }
  const match = retrieve(question,lastTopic);
  if (!match) {add('HIKUN','這題我沒有找到對應的資料。可以試試「TRUZ 的故事」或直接問我「RURU」。'); return;}
  lastTopic = match;
  add('HIKUN','月球電台收到。'+match.text,match.source);
}
byId('form').addEventListener('submit',e => {
  e.preventDefault(); if (!prompt.value.trim()) {send(''); return;}
  send(prompt.value); prompt.value = ''; prompt.focus();
});
document.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click',() => send(button.textContent)));
byId('signal').addEventListener('click',() => {
  send('接收月球訊號'); byId('chat-title').setAttribute('tabindex','-1'); byId('chat-title').focus();
});
voice.disabled = !('speechSynthesis' in window) || !('SpeechSynthesisUtterance' in window);
if (voice.disabled) voice.textContent = '朗讀未支援';
voice.addEventListener('click',() => {
  speaking = !speaking; voice.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(speaking));
  if (!speaking) speechSynthesis.cancel();
  status.textContent = speaking ? '已開啟自動朗讀。' : '已關閉自動朗讀。';
});
byId('reset').addEventListener('click',() => {
  if (recognition) {const active = recognition; recognition = null; active.abort(); mic.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'); mic.textContent = '語音';}
  if (!voice.disabled) speechSynthesis.cancel();
  log.replaceChildren(); prompt.value = ''; lastTopic = null; postcard = 0;
  add('HIKUN',greeting); status.textContent = '已重新開啟對話。'; prompt.focus();
});
const Recognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
if (!Recognition) {mic.disabled = true; status.textContent = '此瀏覽器未支援語音輸入，你可以打字或使用快速提問。';}
mic.addEventListener('click',() => {
  if (recognition) {recognition.stop(); return;}
  const current = new Recognition();
  recognition = current; current.lang = 'zh-TW'; current.maxAlternatives = 1;
  current.onstart = () => {
    if (recognition !== current) return;
    mic.textContent = '停止'; status.textContent = '正在聆聽，請說話。';
  };
  current.onresult = event => {
    if (recognition !== current) return;
    prompt.value = event.results[0][0].transcript.slice(0,240);
    status.textContent = '已轉成文字，可以修改後再送出。'; prompt.focus();
  };
  current.onerror = event => {
    if (recognition !== current) return;
    status.textContent = ['not-allowed','service-not-allowed'].includes(event.error)
      ? '麥克風權限或語音服務不可用，仍可打字提問。' : '沒有取得可用的語音內容，可以再試一次或直接打字。';
  };
  current.onend = () => {
    if (recognition !== current) return;
    recognition = null; mic.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'); mic.textContent = '語音';
    if (['正在聆聽，請說話。','正在啟動麥克風…'].includes(status.textContent)) status.textContent = '語音輸入已結束，可以再試一次或直接打字。';
  };
  try {
    if (!voice.disabled) speechSynthesis.cancel();
    current.start(); mic.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true'); status.textContent = '正在啟動麥克風…';
  } catch { recognition = null; status.textContent = '無法啟動麥克風，可以直接打字。'; }
});
add('HIKUN',greeting);
</script>
</body></html>
